description: Implement a multi-timeframe LEAN C# strategy that uses 4h bars for trend direction (EMA20) and 1h bars for entry timing (RSI14), applied across ~20 liquid crypto futures with per-symbol dual-timeframe state.
agent_prompt: Implement a LEAN C# algorithm in /workspace/src/MultiTimeframe.cs running a multi-timeframe strategy on the top-20 liquid symbols from /workspace/data/universe.json. Requirements: (1) subscribe to all 20 symbols at hourly resolution; (2) use Consolidate() to build 4h bars per symbol; (3) maintain a Dictionary<Symbol, IndicatorPair> with EMA(20) on 4h bars and RSI(14) on 1h bars per symbol; (4) entry rule: 1h RSI signal must agree with 4h EMA trend direction (long: price > EMA20 4h AND RSI 1h < 30; short: price < EMA20 4h AND RSI 1h > 70); (5) ensure 4h indicators only update when a 4h bar completes (no mid-period updates); (6) per-symbol position state with stop-loss; (7) equal-weight sizing across active positions. Run via run_lean_backtest with 3 years of hourly data. Outputs at /workspace/output/: backtest_summary.json (total_return, sharpe, max_drawdown, n_trades), trade_log.csv (per-trade with timestamp, symbol, side, price, qty, indicator_4h_value, indicator_1h_value), per_symbol_summary.csv.

required_capabilities: Subscribe at hourly resolution and Consolidate() to 4h per symbol
Manage per-symbol dual-timeframe indicator state (EMA + RSI)
Implement multi-timeframe entry: 4h trend filter gates 1h entry signal
Ensure 4h indicators only update on 4h bar completion
Manage per-symbol position state with sizing across multiple active positions
